_comment: Public texts of the task page and the scorecard (site/build.py). `title` and `subtitle` replace task.json's title; `references` (each proof of par's design, leaderboard/par.json) and `baselines` (each baseline with a banned operator) describe each design in one sentence (the internal notes of task.json and tests/expected.json are never shown). `new_design_reviewed`: the fingerprints (site/build.py `reviewed_hash`) of the README card's parts the page replaces with its own text, its opening and, with `new_design_checks`, its text on the commands, as last checked against the page; a README edit there warns (fatal under --strict) until the page is checked again.
title: N-bit multiplier
subtitle: The full 2N-bit product of two unsigned N-bit numbers, with logic gates only.

references.mul_n: The N × N array multiplier, partial products summed by rows of full adders, proved with the sv_comb tactics.
references.mul_n_byhand: The same design as `mul_n`, proved by hand without the tactics: the by-hand proof.

baselines.yosys_mul: Yosys's own multiplier, `assign p = a * b;`, which uses the banned `*`: proved with that banlist lifted, so not rankable.
